title: I Replaced 5 Paid Apps With Google's Free AI Tools
description:
Google put out five free AI tools while everyone was watching Claude, and most people have not opened a single one. Stitch designs full app screens and hands you the code. Opal builds automations from a plain English sentence. Google AI Studio turns one prompt into a working shareable site. Flow generates video and images on Google's Veo models. Antigravity is the agentic coding environment that works across all your projects at once.

The fastest way to add free AI tools to your workflow without paying for another subscription.

Get the full guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1JJqkr6W2DRMVmwuEoReZtvRjpDz8CXOv2pqnXL8XHig/edit?usp=sharing

#Shorts #GoogleAI #AITools
